title: The Hollow Wolf
premise: Juniper Sandoval has spent his life as the last keeper of a sealed gate in a valley where magic cannot enter, guarding a door he was told never to open. When a child arrives speaking the dead tongue of Vael, a country erased from every map and memory but his own, Juniper learns the gate doesn't keep magic out — it keeps a dying world in, and that world is running out of dragon-fire to sustain it. Torn between his sworn duty to keep the gate shut and his growing love for both the child, Ash, and the exiled knight who follows her through, Juniper must journey into the hollow remnant of Vael to find its last true door before the final flame gutters out. In the end, Juniper chooses found family over duty: he opens the gate from the inside, letting what remains of Vael pass into the valley — at the cost of his own memories of it, which survive only in the stories Ash will tell.
about_author: Ansel Galloway is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing extinct languages before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about doors, borders, and the people paid to stand between them.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Establishes Juniper's solitary life tending the sealed gate, the valley's strange magiclessness, and the ritual duties passed down by keepers before him. He is dutiful but quietly lonely, talking to the door as if it might answer. Emotional beat: contentment shadowed by an ache he can't name.

chapters.title: A Child at the Threshold
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. A girl of about eight appears at his cottage speaking a language that predates kingdoms; she carries an ember that never cools. When she touches the gate, it hums for the first time in centuries. Juniper takes her in against every rule he knows. Emotional beat: wonder cracking open fear.

chapters.title: The Knight Without a Country
chapters.summary: POV alternating Juniper and Serah, an exiled knight of Vael who crosses the borderlands hunting the child she swore to protect. She reaches the valley wounded, and Juniper must choose whether to shelter her. First friction and first spark between them. Emotional beat: wary trust kindling into attraction.

chapters.title: What the Gate Keeps In
chapters.summary: POV Serah. Through Serah's stories and Ash's ember, Juniper learns the truth inverted: the gate doesn't bar magic from the valley — it pens the dying country of Vael inside a shrinking hollow, sustained by the last dragon-fire. His whole life's duty has been a cage. Emotional beat: betrayal and vertigo.

chapters.title: The Hollow Road
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. The three slip through the gate into Vael's remnant: a country folded small, where streets repeat and the dead walk their old errands. Juniper discovers his keeper's blood lets him see the seams. Emotional beat: grief for a homeland that was never his, felt as if it were.

chapters.title: Ash's Tongue
chapters.summary: POV Serah. Ash reveals she is not a refugee but Vael's last-born, the living vessel of the dragon-fire; hunters called the Gray Wardens want her to burn out the country cleanly. An ambush forces the trio to fight together, and Juniper and Serah admit what they mean to each other. Emotional beat: love declared under threat.

chapters.title: The City That Remembers Him
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. In Vael's capital, the hollowed city recognizes Juniper's bloodline — his ancestors were Vaeldori keepers who built the gate to imprison their own country during a war. He confronts the ghost of the first keeper, who offers him absolution or succession. Emotional beat: identity shattered and re-forged.

chapters.title: The Last Door
chapters.summary: POV Serah. Guided by Ash's ember, they reach the original door beneath the mountain — the one true exit from Vael. But opening it requires a keeper's willing sacrifice of memory: whoever turns the key forgets everything the door has ever held. The Gray Wardens close in. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: Dragon-Fire, Guttering
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Climax. Juniper holds the door against the Wardens while Sera fights them off and Ash's fire gutters toward darkness. Juniper chooses: he turns the key, offering his memories of the valley, the gate, and Serah as the price, and flings the door wide as Vael begins to pour through. Emotional beat: sacrifice at full burn.

chapters.title: Stories Ash Will Tell
chapters.summary: POV Ash. Resolution. The survivors of Vael settle in the valley, which now holds both magic and memory. Juniper remembers nothing of his choice — but wakes each morning to a home full of people, a knight who looks at him like a promise, and a girl telling him stories of a keeper who opened a door. Emotional beat: bittersweet warmth; love outlasting memory.
